villain.name: Max Vathen
villain.known: A billionaire has bought an island nation and is building something on it.
villain.forces: Private security, a fleet, more money than several states.

parts.label: Master Of Their Domain
parts.text: Their reach runs far past themselves - people, money, business, politics.

parts.label: Subversive & Sprawling
parts.text: It is everywhere: operatives in any agency, legitimate-looking or not.

parts.label: Hired Hand
parts.text: They work for the villain because they are paid to. Mercenaries, not believers.

parts.label: Specialist
parts.text: Extremely good at one thing, which is the thing they are here for.

parts.label: Science!
parts.text: A thinker, engineer or inventor, making the important things the villain needs.

parts.label: Fight Club
parts.text: Whatever else they are for, what they want is to fight the player character.

parts.label: True Believer

parts.label: Protege

parts.label: Family Tie
